The hands gripping the bat are indistinct and fused. The fingers do not wrap around the bat handle logically; they appear as a single mass of flesh-colored pixels merging with the bat and the sleeve cuff. Anatomical definition is lost.
The left arm (foreground) seems to emerge from the torso at an awkward angle, and the elbow joint lacks clear definition, appearing slightly melted into the jersey fabric.
The script across the chest resembles text but is illegible and morphologically inconsistent with real typography, typical of AI-generated lettering.
